in_hebrew.name: Stanleigh
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Stone from the woodland
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Stanleigh הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from Old English, Stanleigh is a compound name consisting of 'stan' meaning stone and 'leah' meaning wood or clearing. The name was commonly given to those who lived near a wooded area with a prominent stone feature.
